info.title: OpenSkateMap API
info.description: The API behind the OpenSkateMap app. Every response is an envelope: `{ ok: true, data }` or `{ ok: false, error }`.

bearerAuth.description: The session token the app receives from POST /v1/auth/apple

pushIdentity.description: Pass to BuzzKit's identify as `identityHash` (the id is `id`); null while push isn't set up

nonce.description: The raw nonce; the app sent its SHA-256 hex digest to Apple

authorizationCode.description: ASAuthorizationAppleIDCredential.authorizationCode, so deleting the account can revoke Apple's tokens

items.description: Published spots changed after the cursor, oldest first

tombstones.description: Ids of spots removed after the cursor; delete them locally. Always empty for cursor 0: a fresh install has nothing to delete

nextCursor.description: Pass back as `cursor`; store it only after applying this page

hasMore.description: Another page is ready now; ask again right away

resetRequired.description: The cursor is not one this server issued (its data was reset). Re-index from cursor 0 without wiping first

version.description: Increases with every change to any spot; the sync cursor

obstacles.description: What's there to skate (ledges, rails, …), so apps can filter the map offline

missing.description: Requested ids that are not published spots you can see; stop asking for them

photos.description: In display order; the first is the cover

videos.description: Approved YouTube and Instagram videos of the spot, oldest first

SpotVisibility.description: public: on the map. private: only in collections, seen by their people

credit.description: Who took it: the photographer named by the submitter, else the uploader's name; null if unknown

createdAt.description: When it was added to the spot

key.description: The MP4 at https://images.openskatemap.app/<key>, served as it is (no image transformations)

SpotPhotoClip.description: A short clip that plays in place of the photo, muted and looped; the photo is its poster

externalId.description: YouTube's video id or Instagram's shortcode

url.description: The normalised link; open it in the platform's app or the browser

startSeconds.description: YouTube only: where the clip starts

thumbnailUrl.description: YouTube only; Instagram has no thumbnail without an API key

addedBy.description: Null when unknown, or for a viewer who blocked them

mine.description: The viewer's own vote: 1 up, -1 down, 0 none

name.description: In English; what to show in a language `names` doesn't have

names.description: The name in each of the apps' languages (ar, de, en, es, fr, hi, it, ja, pl, pt, ru, tr, uk, zh-Hans, zh-Hant), so an app picks its own offline; empty for a city whose names aren't filled yet

SpotRemoval.description: An admin's takedown; on a submission, the history keeps its row and says why

SpotRemovalReason.description: Why an admin took a spot down; its submitter sees it

city.description: The city's name; null outside every city

version.description: Changes whenever the spot does; part of the card image's URL

features.description: Every city, shown in the apps or not yet, by slug

get.description: For spots the local index doesn't have yet (a sync still running); rows are what the sync sends. Names are compared in Latin letters (Cyrillic romanised, so `novokrest` finds Новокрестовская), ignoring case and accents, with ё as е and й as и or y. First spots where every word of `q` starts a word of the name or of its city's name in any of the apps' languages; then names containing every word; then, to fill `limit`, names with a word one letter off (two from 8 letters) for words of 5 letters or more. Within each, nearest to `latitude`/`longitude` first when given, then by name.

put.summary: Take a spot off the map
put.description: Admins only, public or private spots. The spot is marked removed, never deleted: the sync sends it as a tombstone, details and collections stop returning it, and its submitter's history shows it removed with the reason. Taking down a taken-down spot changes nothing and answers its first removal.

put.summary: Send a new spot for review
put.description: An admin's spot is published at once (answered as approved, by its author). The id is the app's outbox id: send the same id on every retry and the server keeps one submission. While it is pending, sending it again replaces it; once a curator has decided, it returns the decision unchanged. Upload the photos first; a 422 lists `missingPhotos` in its details.

put.summary: Edit a published spot, or suggest an edit to it
put.description: Only what differs from the spot counts; with nothing left it answers 422. An admin's edit applies at once (answered as approved, by its author); anyone else's waits for review. Same id rules as `saveSubmission`: send the same id on every retry; a pending edit is replaced, a decided one returns unchanged. Upload added photos first; a 422 lists `missingPhotos`. A private, removed or unknown spot answers 404.

put.summary: Send a YouTube or Instagram video of a spot for review
put.description: The id is the app's outbox id: send the same id on every retry and the server keeps one video. While it is pending, sending it again replaces the link and caption; once a curator has decided, it returns the decision unchanged. A link that isn't a YouTube video or an Instagram post or reel, or a new YouTube video that no longer plays there (private or removed, per YouTube's oEmbed), is a 422; the same clip already waiting or shown on the spot is a 409.
